Invoice PDF pagination is now fixed and validated. The failed 86-line invoice case was traced to `_draw_page()`: continuation-page table-header space was repeatedly reserved. Header height is now computed once per document in `render_invoice()`, correctly increasing the available page-height budget while preserving headers on continuation pages. The complete PDF suite passes (`14 passed, 1 skipped`), with four existing golden PDFs remaining byte-stable. The broader billing suite also passes (`83 passed, 4 skipped`), confirming no downstream regressions. The final diff contains four changed files (`217 insertions`, `184 deletions`) and `git diff --check` reports no whitespace errors.

Earlier PDF polish is complete: negative credit lines render beside their related item, zero amounts remain omitted, and locale-aware shared money formatting is covered for positive, negative, and zero values. Baseline and formatting checks pass, and Ruff is clean.

The next useful step is visual inspection/comparison of the three generated PDFs, especially the long two-page invoice, to verify spacing, continuation headers, credits, totals, and overall page-break quality. Afterward, run any final repository-wide checks if desired. Keep Docker based on `python:3.12.9-slim`. March 2025 payroll v3 still requires the prescribed approval sequence before execution.
